published.description: Notes published after this date, absolute like 2024-01-01 or relative like -3d.

topic.description: Topic entity id, see [list](https://docs.recordedfuture.com/reference/analyst-note-available-topics) of available ones for details.

limit.description: Maximum number of references from which notes are fetched, at most 1000.

from.description: Offset the result based on next_offset from a previous search response

enterprise_only.description: When true, restricts results to notes authored by your organization (excludes Insikt Group notes).

EscapeHtmlParam.description: Determines if HTML tags are escaped, applied only when `tagged_text = true`.

RequestSerializationParam.description: Entity serialization level. When set to `id`, only the entity id will be included. Setting it to `min` leads to the id and name being included and setting it to `full` means that each entity will have the id, name, type and possibly a description included in the response.

RequestTaggedTextParam.description: Determines if the `<entity></entity>` tags should be inline with entities in the note title and text.
